prompts.text: What's a film you enjoy revisiting even though you know every major turn?
Tell me about watching a movie at the right moment for its story to resonate.
Rewatch a dependable favourite or choose a film you've heard about for years?
You have one quiet evening and can't decide what to watch. What helps narrow the choice?
The films people return to often reflect moods as much as genres.
An enjoyable movie doesn't have to be complicated to deserve another viewing.
Which film do you associate with a particular place or person?
Recall a friend recommending a film that turned out to suit you perfectly.
You are curating a small cinema evening for people with different tastes. What would you ask them first?
A character-driven drama or a light comedy with a familiar cast?
What makes a television series easy for you to settle into after a long day?
Describe discovering a show several years after everyone else had finished discussing it.
Watch one episode at a time or save a few to enjoy over the weekend?
Your favourite series ends and you want something with a similar feeling. What would you look for?
A series can become comforting through familiar characters even when individual episodes are ordinary.
Shorter seasons can make a story more satisfying when there's less filler.
Which supporting character has made a show more enjoyable for you?
Recall a series finale that encouraged a thoughtful conversation among friends.
Someone wants a show they can watch in short sessions. What matters more than its popularity?
A complete miniseries or an ongoing story you can follow over time?
What's a documentary that made an everyday subject surprisingly interesting?
Tell me about watching something factual that led you to ask more questions.
Explore a nature documentary or one about a creative person's working process?
You can choose the subject of a short documentary about your neighbourhood. What would you film?
Good nonfiction storytelling can make an unfamiliar topic understandable without removing its complexity.
A documentary should make viewers curious enough to ask what might be missing.
Which ordinary profession would you enjoy seeing explored in a behind-the-scenes film?
Recall learning about a historical event through a documentary rather than a textbook.
You could interview one person for a ten-minute documentary. What life experience would interest you?
Follow one personal story or explore a big subject through several perspectives?
What kind of book holds your attention even when you're reading in short bursts?
Describe discovering a favourite author through an unexpected recommendation.
An engaging collection of short stories or a novel you can stay immersed in?
A friend is getting back into reading after years away. What would you ask before recommending a book?
Readers sometimes connect most strongly with characters who make mistakes they recognise.
A book doesn't have to be long to leave a lasting impression.
Which story setting do you enjoy spending time in, even if the plot moves slowly?
Recall reading a passage that made you notice something different about ordinary life.
You have to choose one book for a relaxed neighbourhood discussion. What would make it approachable?
A mystery you want to solve or a reflective story about familiar relationships?
What's a board game that makes a gathering more relaxed rather than more competitive?
Tell me about learning a game from somebody who was especially patient with beginners.
Play a cooperative game where everyone shares a goal or a simple turn-based challenge?
Four people meet for an evening and none knows the others' games. What would you choose first?
The best games for a casual group are often easy to explain but leave room for surprising choices.
A good game night doesn't require anyone to keep score.
Which childhood game still works well at an adult gathering?
Recall a friendly competition where the funniest moment had nothing to do with winning.
You need to adapt a game for players with different abilities. What would you ask them about comfort and access?
A quick guessing game or a longer puzzle you can solve together?
What theatre performance or stage production would you like to experience again?
Describe seeing performers create an entire world with a small stage and few props.
A small intimate play or a large musical with an elaborate production?
A friend has never seen a live stage performance. How would you help them choose a suitable first show?
The audience's reactions can make a stage production feel different on every night.
Creative staging can be more memorable than expensive scenery.
Which kind of story do you think works particularly well in live theatre?
Recall an actor's performance changing how you understood a character.
A local theatre group asks residents what stories matter to them. What might you suggest?
Watch a familiar classic staged differently or discover a completely new play?
Which childhood cartoon or animated film would you happily watch today?
Tell me about discovering a clever detail in a children's story that you missed when younger.
Hand-drawn animation with expressive characters or detailed computer animation?
A friend asks for one animated film suitable for a relaxed evening. What would guide your suggestion?
Animation can convey emotions and ideas that would feel very different in live action.
An animated story doesn't become less serious simply because children can enjoy it.
Which animated character did you understand differently as an adult?
Recall hearing a familiar voice actor in another programme and recognising them immediately.
You can design an animated short based on an ordinary event. Which moment would you choose?
An imaginative fantasy setting or a warm story about everyday life?
What's your favourite part of visiting a cinema aside from watching the film itself?
Describe a screening where the audience helped make the experience memorable.
Attend a quiet early showing or an evening screening with friends?
A cinema offers a relaxed classic-film night with a discussion afterwards. What kind of film would suit it?
Watching a story with strangers can feel different from watching it alone at home.
A comfortable cinema seat and clear sound matter more than elaborate extras.
Which film would you most enjoy introducing to somebody who's never seen it?
Recall seeing a familiar film on a large screen for the first time.
You could improve one aspect of the cinema experience for regular visitors. What would you change?
A small independent cinema or a large modern multiplex?
Which kind of comedy helps you relax without needing to pay attention to every detail?
Tell me about a performance that made you laugh for an unexpected reason.
Observational stand-up about everyday life or a situation comedy with familiar characters?
A friend is visiting and wants a light evening of entertainment. What would you offer besides a film?
Comedians often make ordinary frustrations interesting by noticing details everyone shares.
A good joke doesn't need to embarrass somebody in the room.
Which everyday topic would you enjoy hearing a clever comedian explore?
Recall a funny show you discovered because somebody played you a short clip.
You can plan a local evening where amateurs share short funny stories. What would make the event welcoming?
A thoughtful comedy special or a lively improv performance?
What's an entertainment experience you'd enjoy that doesn't involve a screen?
Describe visiting a community event and discovering a performer or storyteller you didn't know.
An afternoon storytelling session or a small cultural festival with different activities?
You have a free weekend and want something relaxing but unfamiliar. How would you find a suitable event?
Local entertainment can reveal as much about a community as its famous attractions.
A free public event can be more memorable than a heavily advertised attraction.
Which small cultural event would you like your city to host more often?
Recall a public performance that made you stop and watch longer than you planned.
Your neighbourhood can host one monthly entertainment activity in a shared space. What would appeal to different age groups?
A public storytelling evening or a casual outdoor film screening?
